hook: Two rocket boosters fell out of the sky and landed upright.
narration: Two rocket boosters fell out of the sky, and both landed standing up.
Minutes earlier, they were strapped to the sides of a Falcon Heavy, lifting a NASA space telescope off the Florida coast.
Twenty seven engines lit at once.
Then the two side boosters shut down and broke away.
Each one fires its engines three times to get home. Once to turn back, once to slow down before the thick air, and once to land.
They fell back toward Cape Canaveral, aiming for two separate landing zones.
[short pause] The landing legs only swing open in the final seconds.
One dropped onto its pad in a storm of fire and smoke.
Cameras around the Cape tracked them the whole way down.
outcome: Both side boosters landed, and the Roman Space Telescope flew free on its way.
title: Two rocket boosters land themselves
description:
On Aug. 30, 2026, a SpaceX Falcon Heavy launched NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope from Kennedy Space Center, then both of its side boosters flew back and landed at Cape Canaveral, Florida.
